31/S0.subgoal: Identify the five senses and the specific topics to be covered regarding touch, taste, smell, and proprioception.

31/S1.subgoal: Explain the human somatosensory system and the receptors responsible for touch and proprioception.

31/S2.subgoal: Describe the neural mechanism by which the brain processes touch and initiates motor responses.

31/S3.subgoal: Explain haptic perception and the different types of haptic exploration used to build mental models.

31/S4.subgoal: Describe various methods and devices used to provide touch sensations in XR systems.

31/S5.subgoal: Describe the chemical senses of smell and taste and the current state of their interfaces in XR.

31/S6.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
